## Description

Add skills/analyze-sessions/targets.md. It maps metric patterns to the four fix targets: se-workflow skills, the artifact contract, CLAUDE.md and steering files, and automated checks. Each pattern names fields from the aggregate output, such as tools[].error_rate, outliers.retries, efforts.*.cost_exclusive, skills[].sessions and caveats.ambiguous_share, and says where its fix goes and why. Keep it short; it is read only when the skill reaches the mapping step.
record.subject: as-targets
